title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Request a Refund
content:
Refund requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis:

- Contact support through the app > 'Help' > 'Request Refund'
- Provide your ticket number and reason for the request
- Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days if approved
- Refunds for experiences already attended are generally not available
- Double charges are automatically escalated to our billing team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To request a refund, please go to Help > Request Refund in the CultPass app. Include your ticket number and reason. Our team will review and respond within 5-7 business days."

title: Understanding Your Billing Cycle
content:
CultPass subscriptions bill on a monthly cycle:

- Billing occurs on the same day each month as your original sign-up date
- Charges appear as 'CULTPASS' on your statement
- You can view your billing history in the app > 'My Account' > 'Billing'
- Failed payments result in a 7-day grace period before service suspension
- Update your payment method at any time in the Billing section

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your subscription renews monthly on the same day you signed up. You can view all charges in My Account > Billing in the app."

title: How to Dispute a Double Charge
content:
If you believe you were charged twice:

1. Check your billing history in the app > 'My Account' > 'Billing'
2. If you see duplicate charges, contact support immediately
3. Our team will investigate and typically resolve within 24 hours
4. If approved, a refund for the duplicate charge will be issued
5. For urgent cases, escalate to our billing team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Double charges are unusual but can happen. Let me check your billing history and we'll sort this out quickly. I can see your recent charges and investigate any duplicates."
tags: double charge, duplicate, billing, refund, dispute

title: How to Update Your Email Address
content:
Updating your email address is straightforward:

- Go to the CultPass app > 'My Account' > 'Profile'
- Tap on your current email address
- Enter your new email and confirm
- A verification link will be sent to the new address
- Your login credentials will switch to the new email after verification

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your email in My Account > Profile. Just tap your email, enter the new one, and confirm the verification link we'll send you."

title: How to Delete Your CultPass Account
content:
Account deletion is a permanent action:

- Go to the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' > 'Delete Account'
- You will be asked to confirm your password
- All your data will be permanently removed within 30 days
- Cancel your subscription first before deleting
- This action cannot be undone

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To delete your account, go to My Account > Manage Plan > Delete Account. Please note this is permanent - cancel your subscription first if you have an active plan."

title: App Crashes on Event Reservation
content:
If the app crashes when trying to reserve:

1. Force close the app and restart it
2. Check for app updates in your device's app store
3. Clear the app cache: Settings > Apps > CultPass > Clear Cache
4. Ensure you have a stable internet connection
5. If the issue persists, try reserving via the web version at cultpass.com
6. Report the crash with details (device model, OS version) to our tech team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"I'm sorry you're experiencing crashes. Please try force-closing the app and restarting it. If that doesn't work, check for updates or clear the app cache."
tags: crash, app issue, technical, reservation, bug

title: QR Code Not Scanning at Check-In
content:
If your QR code won't scan at event check-in:

1. Increase your screen brightness to maximum
2. Ensure the QR code is fully visible on your screen
3. Ask the venue staff to try scanning from a different angle
4. If available, use the check-in code (last 4 digits) as a backup
5. Contact support if the issue persists and we can verify your reservation manually

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try increasing your screen brightness and holding the QR code flat for scanning. If scanning continues to fail, ask the venue staff for the manual check-in option using your reservation code."
tags: qr code, scanning, check-in, event, technical

title: Video Streaming Issues on Web
content:
If you experience buffering or playback issues:

1. Check your internet connection speed (minimum 5 Mbps recommended)
2. Close other browser tabs and applications
3. Clear your browser cache and cookies
4. Try a different browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge recommended)
5. Disable VPN or ad-blocker extensions temporarily
6. If the issue persists, try restarting your router

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Streaming issues are often related to internet speed. Please check your connection and try clearing your browser cache. If using a VPN, try disabling it."

title: Upgrading from Basic to Premium
content:
Upgrading your plan is easy:

- Go to the CultPass app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'
- Select 'Upgrade to Premium'
- Premium includes: unlimited monthly experiences, priority booking, exclusive events
- The upgrade takes effect immediately
- Your billing date will remain the same
- Prorated charges apply for the remainder of your current billing cycle

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can upgrade to Premium anytime in My Account > Manage Plan. Premium gives you unlimited monthly experiences and priority booking."

title: Downgrading Your Plan
content:
Downgrading from Premium to Basic:

- Go to the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'
- Select 'Change Plan' and choose Basic
- Downgrade takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle
- Premium features will remain active until the cycle ends
- Monthly experience limit will reduce to 4 after downgrade
- No refunds for the remaining premium days

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To downgrade, go to My Account > Manage Plan and select Basic. The change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle."

title: Understanding the Experience Rating System
content:
CultPass allows you to rate experiences you've attended:

- After an event, a rating prompt appears in the app
- Rate from 1 to 5 stars based on your experience
- Leave a written review to help other members
- Ratings are anonymous and public
- You can edit or delete your review within 7 days
- Highly-rated events get featured in the app

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can rate experiences you've attended directly in the app. A rating prompt will appear after your event. Your feedback helps the community!"

title: How to Leave Reviews After an Event
content:
Leaving a review after attending an experience:

1. Open the CultPass app and go to 'My Reservations'
2. Find the experience you attended
3. Tap 'Leave a Review'
4. Select a star rating (1-5)
5. Optionally write a short description of your experience
6. Submit the review
7. You can include photos to make your review more helpful

**Suggested phrasing:**
"After attending an experience, go to My Reservations in the app, select the event, and tap 'Leave a Review'. Share your thoughts and photos!"

title: Getting Started with CultPass
content:
Welcome to CultPass! Here's how to get started:

1. Download the CultPass app from the App Store or Google Play
2. Create your account using your email or social login
3. Browse the experience catalog in your city
4. Reserve your first experience
5. Attend the event - bring your QR code
6. Share your feedback after the experience

Your subscription gives you access to curated cultural experiences. Each month you can book based on your plan tier.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Welcome! Start by downloading the CultPass app, creating an account, and browsing available experiences. Your first reservation is just a few taps away!"
tags: onboarding, getting started, welcome, new user

title: How to Download and Set Up the App
content:
Setting up CultPass on your device:

1. iOS: Download from the App Store
2. Android: Download from Google Play Store
3. After install, open the app and tap 'Create Account'
4. Enter your name, email, and create a password
5. Verify your email via the confirmation link
6. Complete your profile (optional but recommended)
7. Browse the catalog and start reserving!

Minimum requirements: iOS 14+ or Android 8+, stable internet connection.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Download the CultPass app from your device's app store, create an account, verify your email, and you're all set to explore experiences!"
